tasks.name: Compile environmental baseline and site constraints
tasks.description: Collect air attainment status, receiving waters, wetlands, endangered species, zoning, nearby receptors and existing permit limits for candidate sites.

consumes.use: existing permits, emission caps and netting history, existing source baseline
existing permit limits and conditions (Title V, NPDES)
candidate site location and access rules
per site topography, flood elevation and relocation needs; wetland/floodplain screening
existing ground levels, outfalls, existing roads and buildings
permit-related milestones and construction start date

tasks.name: Screen configuration options for inherent safety and environmental impact
tasks.description: Rank configuration and site options for inventory, toxic exposure, offsite consequence, emissions and permit risk.

consumes.use: block flow options with major streams and capacities
per option H&MB, major equipment duties and inventories
per option fuel, power demand and CO2 estimate
attainment status, receptors and permit triggers

tasks.name: Facilitate concept HAZID and ENVID
tasks.description: Run HAZID/ENVID workshops on the selected concept and record hazards, safeguards and actions.

consumes.use: major equipment, fluids and main control loops
block footprints, flare location, tank farm, roads and neighbours
operations and maintenance requirements and input
environmental aspects and constraints for ENVID

tasks.name: Provide safety and environmental input to site selection
tasks.description: Evaluate candidate sites for separation from public receptors, flood/seismic exposure, permit difficulty and emergency access.

consumes.use: topography, flood elevation, access routes per candidate site
seismic parameters, wind and flood level
candidate site data, climatic data and access rules
receptors and permit constraints per site

tasks.name: Compile hazardous materials inventory and properties
tasks.description: List hazardous materials, inventories and flammability/toxicity properties by process area for studies, HAC and PSI.

consumes.use: stream composition, phase, P, T, H2S and benzene content
composition, inventory, flash point, MW and toxic content per isolatable section
vessel and column liquid levels and dimensions for holdup inventories
chemicals and catalysts with hazard class and first-fill/storage quantities
crude sulfur content and assay data for H2S/mercaptan potential

tasks.name: Prepare SHE design basis and risk criteria
tasks.description: Define applicable codes (OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, API 752/753/2218, NFPA), risk tolerance criteria, design accidental loads and study scope.

consumes.use: owner SHE standards and order of precedence
codes and standards and design basis structure in execution plan

tasks.name: Prepare fire protection and F&G philosophy
tasks.description: Set the strategy for active and passive fire protection, fire water, F&G detection, voting and executive actions.

consumes.use: codes, design fire loads, F&G targets, fire water basis
owner fire protection and insurer standards
DCS/SIS/F&G split and F&G system concept

tasks.name: Run preliminary consequence modelling for layout spacing
tasks.description: Model representative fire, explosion and toxic releases to set spacing, building locations and sterile zones on the plot plan.

consumes.use: release streams: composition, P, T, phase, inventory per isolatable section
equipment and building locations to grid
wind speed and ambient design data

tasks.name: Develop emissions inventory
tasks.description: Calculate potential-to-emit for each source (heaters, flares, tanks, fugitives, loading, cooling towers) to establish permit applicability.

consumes.use: CO2/NOx/SOx/VOC per point source, flare and vent streams; fugitive emissions basis and component service counts
fired duty, fuel composition and emission limits
fuel gas balance and flare purge/pilot use
burner type, NOx guarantee, stack height
tank throughput, vapour pressure and breathing data

tasks.name: Prepare air permit application
tasks.description: Compile air construction permit (NSR/PSD or minor) application with dispersion modelling and BACT analysis.

consumes.use: PTE per source and stack parameters
building and stack locations for downwash

tasks.name: Prepare water, stormwater and spill permit data
tasks.description: Prepare NPDES/pretreatment data, construction and industrial stormwater basis, and SPCC containment requirements.

consumes.use: wastewater flow, composition, temperature and solid/liquid waste
runoff volumes, first flush, discharge points

tasks.name: Facilitate preliminary (coarse) HAZOP
tasks.description: Run a coarse HAZOP on PFDs and preliminary P&IDs to find major design changes before FEED freeze.

consumes.use: IFR P&IDs with relief and trip loops

tasks.name: Perform facility siting study (API RP 752/753)
tasks.description: Assess explosion, fire and toxic hazards to occupied permanent and portable buildings and set building design loads.

consumes.use: congestion and confinement (equipment, piping density) per area
building plans, construction type and dimensions
release scenarios: composition, P, T, inventory per isolatable section

tasks.name: Assess toxic gas ingress and shelter-in-place
tasks.description: Evaluate toxic and smoke ingress to occupied buildings and set HVAC shutdown, gas detection at intakes and shelter-in-place requirements.

consumes.use: intake gas detection, damper closure and HVAC trips
occupied building locations and siting decisions

tasks.name: Perform quantitative risk assessment
tasks.description: Calculate individual and societal risk from leak frequencies and consequences and compare to criteria.

consumes.use: isolatable section inventory, composition, P, T
ESD valve stroke time and failure position
flange, valve and instrument counts per section for leak frequency

tasks.name: Check flare radiation, noise and dispersion
tasks.description: Verify flare stack height and sterile radius for radiation, flame-out dispersion and noise against personnel and equipment limits.

consumes.use: relief rate, MW, T and composition per governing scenario
flare location, access roads and nearby equipment

tasks.name: Review relief and depressuring scenarios
tasks.description: Check that relief and blowdown scenarios cover HAZOP causes and fire zones and comment on the relief study.

consumes.use: relief scenarios and loads per device
depressuring per segment and time to target

tasks.name: Facilitate formal HAZOP
tasks.description: Organize, facilitate and record the node-by-node HAZOP of IFH P&IDs with all disciplines and operations.

consumes.use: PSV set pressures and governing cases

tasks.name: Run LOPA and set SIL targets
tasks.description: Analyse HAZOP high-consequence scenarios with LOPA, credit IPLs and assign required SIL to each SIF.

consumes.use: process safety time, trip set points and final elements
SIF definitions with initiators, voting and final elements
LOPA target frequencies and IPL credit rules

tasks.name: Track and close out PHA and study actions
tasks.description: Track HAZID, HAZOP, LOPA, siting and QRA actions to closure with documented discipline responses.

consumes.use: owner acceptance of responses and residual risk

tasks.name: Perform fire and gas detector mapping
tasks.description: Place flame, gas, H2S and heat detectors and verify geographic/scenario coverage against targets.

consumes.use: area classification for detector Ex rating
gas composition and H2S content per area

tasks.name: Calculate fire water demand
tasks.description: Size fire water demand for the largest credible fire scenario and set pump capacity, storage and network requirements.

consumes.use: fire zones, dikes and equipment positions

tasks.name: Define fire scenario envelopes and fireproofing zones
tasks.description: Define fire-potential envelopes (API 2218) and list structures, supports, cables and valves requiring fireproofing.

consumes.use: ESD valve fire-proofing need and locations

tasks.name: Specify emergency isolation valve requirements
tasks.description: Identify where remotely operated emergency isolation valves are needed and set fire-safe and closure requirements.

consumes.use: pump/compressor suction sources and isolation points

tasks.name: Specify fixed fire protection systems
tasks.description: Define deluge, water spray, foam, clean agent and portable extinguisher requirements by area per NFPA.

consumes.use: tank roof type, rim seal and diameter
electrical and I&C room layouts for clean agent

tasks.name: Lay out safety equipment and escape routes
tasks.description: Locate safety showers, eyewashes, escape routes, muster points, windsocks and second means of egress.

tasks.name: Perform noise study
tasks.description: Set equipment noise limits and model plant and fence-line noise against occupational and community limits.

consumes.use: PSV and flare noise source rates

tasks.name: Review plot plan and 3D model for safety
tasks.description: Participate in model reviews checking spacing, escape, access for firefighting, safety equipment and siting conformance.

tasks.name: Review hazardous area classification
tasks.description: Check hazardous area classification against release sources, gas groups and ventilation assumptions.

tasks.name: Review cause and effect and SIL verification
tasks.description: Check C&E charts and SIL verification against LOPA targets, F&G executive actions and HAZOP recommendations.

tasks.name: Review vendor packages and bids for SHE compliance
tasks.description: Review technical bids and vendor data for noise, emissions guarantees, fire-safe valves, safety devices and package HAZOP needs.

consumes.use: certified noise and safety device data

tasks.name: Facilitate vendor package and design change HAZOPs
tasks.description: Run HAZOPs on vendor package P&IDs and HAZOP revalidation of design changes since the main HAZOP.

tasks.name: Compile process safety information for PSM
tasks.description: Assemble OSHA 1910.119 process safety information and PHA records for handover to the owner PSM program.

tasks.name: Prepare RMP hazard assessment and registration data
tasks.description: Model worst-case and alternative release scenarios and prepare EPA RMP registration and program data.

tasks.name: Provide emergency response planning input
tasks.description: Provide scenarios, zones, alarms, muster and fire response resources for the owner emergency response plan.

tasks.name: Prepare construction environmental compliance plan
tasks.description: Translate permit conditions into construction requirements for stormwater, dust, waste, spill and notifications.

tasks.name: Perform MOC safety reviews of field and design changes
tasks.description: Screen field changes and RFIs for process safety impact and decide whether HAZOP revalidation, siting or PSI updates are needed.

tasks.name: Lead pre-startup safety review (PSSR)
tasks.description: Verify construction matches design, PHA actions are closed, procedures and training are in place and systems are safe to start.

consumes.use: C&E and SIF function test records

tasks.name: Set up environmental startup compliance
tasks.description: Prepare startup notifications, initial performance tests, CEMS certification and LDAR component inventory.

consumes.use: as-built P&IDs and line data for LDAR tagging

tasks.name: Update safety studies to as-built and hand over
tasks.description: Revise siting, F&G mapping, QRA and fire protection studies to as-built condition for the owner PSM records.

items.name: Environmental constraints register
items.content: Attainment status and PSD/NSR applicability triggers, receiving water limits, wetland and habitat constraints, nearby receptors and fence-line distances, noise limits at property line, permit lead times.

items.name: Option SHE screening ranking
items.content: Per option: inherent safety score, toxic/flammable inventory, worst-case offsite distance, emissions estimate and permitting pathway (minor vs major source), recommended option and risks.

items.name: HAZID / ENVID register
items.content: Hazards by area and node, causes, consequences, existing safeguards, risk ranking against owner matrix, environmental aspects.

items.name: HAZID actions list
items.content: Action number, description, responsible discipline, due phase, priority; used to steer layout, philosophy and design basis.

items.name: Site selection SHE assessment
items.content: Per site: distance to public receptors, preliminary worst-case hazard zones, flood/wind exposure, permit complexity score, emergency services access; recommended site.

items.name: Hazardous materials inventory and properties
items.content: Material, area, inventory (kg), flash point, LFL/UFL, autoignition temperature, gas group/T-class, IDLH/ERPG/AEGL, RMP threshold quantity check, OSHA PSM threshold check.

items.name: SHE design basis
items.content: Codes and regulations, risk tolerance criteria, design blast and fire loads method, toxic thresholds, F&G performance targets, fire water design basis, noise limits, emission targets and study schedule.

items.name: Fire protection and F&G philosophy
items.content: Fire water source and redundancy, fixed system types per hazard, fireproofing criteria (API 2218), detector types, coverage targets, voting (2ooN), executive actions, alarm and beacon philosophy.

items.name: Preliminary hazard distances and spacing comments
items.content: Jet/pool fire radiation distances, flash fire extents, overpressure contours, toxic distances, recommended equipment spacing changes, building locations and sterile areas; marked-up plot plan.

items.name: Emissions inventory
items.content: Per source: tag, pollutant (NOx, CO, VOC, SO2, PM, HAPs, GHG CO2e), emission factor basis, hourly and annual PTE, stack parameters (height, diameter, temperature, velocity, location).

items.name: Emission control requirements
items.content: BACT/LAER and NSPS/NESHAP requirements by source: low-NOx burner or SCR, CEMS, tank seal type and vapour control, LDAR program, flare monitoring (40 CFR 63 CC) requirements to PROC, MECH and INST.

items.name: Air permit application package
items.content: Application forms, emission calculations, dispersion modelling results, BACT analysis, regulatory applicability review, submitted to the agency.

items.name: Permit conditions register
items.content: Each permit condition: source, limit, monitoring/recordkeeping requirement, design impact, construction/startup notification deadline, responsible party.

items.name: Wastewater and stormwater permit data
items.content: Effluent characterization, outfall data, NOI and SWPPP basis, pretreatment limits, monitoring points.

items.name: Secondary containment and spill control requirements
items.content: SPCC-covered containers, required containment volumes (110% plus rainfall), dike and curb locations, contaminated firewater runoff containment, oil/water separator basis; to CIVL.

items.name: Preliminary HAZOP actions
items.content: Actions requiring design change (overpressure scenarios, isolation, materials, layout), responsible discipline, priority.

items.name: Building blast loads
items.content: Per building: side-on peak overpressure, impulse, duration and reflected loads by wall, design frequency basis; to CIVL for blast-resistant design.

items.name: Building siting decisions and occupancy restrictions
items.content: Building acceptability per API 752, relocation or hardening required, occupancy limits, control room and lab location agreement.

items.name: Portable building siting restrictions
items.content: Exclusion zones for trailers per API 753 for construction, turnaround and commissioning; allowed locations and construction requirements.

items.name: Building toxic ingress and HVAC shutdown requirements
items.content: Required H2S/flammable detectors at HVAC intakes, damper closure times, building tightness, shelter-in-place capability, CO2/SCBA provisions; to CIVL (HVAC) and INST.

items.name: QRA results
items.content: Individual risk contours, location-specific risk, F-N curve, PLL, risk ranking of contributors, comparison to criteria.

items.name: QRA risk reduction recommendations
items.content: Recommended measures (isolation valves, detection, spacing, inventory reduction) with risk benefit, owner discipline and status.

items.name: Flare radiation and sterile zone results
items.content: Radiation contours at grade (1.58, 4.73, 6.31, 9.46 kW/m2), sterile zone radius, dispersion of unignited release and H2S, noise at boundary; required stack height changes.

items.name: Relief study review comments
items.content: Comments on missing scenarios, fire-case wetted areas versus fire zones, depressuring target times (API 521), and credited safeguards.

items.name: HAZOP worksheets and report
items.content: Nodes, design intent, deviations, causes, consequences, safeguards, severity/likelihood ranking, attendance and P&ID revision basis.

items.name: HAZOP recommendations register
items.content: Recommendation number, P&ID and node, description, responsible discipline and person, priority, due date, LOPA referral flag.

items.name: LOPA scenarios and SIL targets
items.content: Per scenario: initiating event and frequency, enabling conditions, IPLs credited with PFD, mitigated frequency, gap; per SIF: tag, required SIL/RRF, process safety time, safe state; to INST for SRS.

items.name: Non-SIF IPL and safeguard requirements
items.content: Credited BPCS loops, alarms with operator response time, PSVs, check valves and mechanical IPLs requiring independence, testing and management as safety-critical.

items.name: Action close-out records
items.content: Per action: response, evidence document number and revision, verification by SAFE, owner acceptance, closure date; open items carried to PSSR.

items.name: F&G detector layout and coverage
items.content: Detector tag, type, location coordinates, elevation, orientation, coverage maps and achieved coverage per zone; to INST for F&G system design and PIPE/INST for installation.

items.name: F&G zones and executive action requirements
items.content: F&G zone list, detector voting per zone, alarm and executive actions (ESD, deluge release, HVAC trip, beacons), to INST for F&G C&E.

items.name: Fire water demand and pump duty
items.content: Design scenario, deluge/monitor/hydrant/foam flows, total demand, required residual pressure, duration and storage volume; to MECH for fire pump datasheets and PROC utility balance.

items.name: Fire water network, hydrant and monitor layout requirements
items.content: Ring main sizing basis, hydrant and monitor locations and spacing, isolation valve sectioning, hose reel and foam connection locations; to PIPE/CIVL.

items.name: Fire zones and fireproofing envelopes
items.content: Fire-scenario envelope boundaries in plan and elevation, fire zone numbers for relief fire case and deluge.

items.name: Fireproofing requirements list
items.content: Steel members, skirts, vessel supports, cable trays and actuators needing fireproofing, rating (hours), test standard (UL 1709), extent; to CIVL, ELEC, INST.

items.name: Emergency isolation valve requirements
items.content: EIV/ROEIV location, initiating causes, closure time, fire-safe test (API 607), fireproofing of actuator and cable, operation point outside fire zone; to PROC and INST.

items.name: Fixed fire protection system requirements
items.content: System type and coverage per area (NFPA 11/13/15/2001), design density, deluge valve locations and activation logic, extinguisher schedule; to MECH (package requisition) and INST.

items.name: Safety equipment and escape route layout
items.content: Locations of safety showers/eyewashes (with utility needs), escape routes, muster points, windsocks, alarm beacons and horns; to PIPE, CIVL and ELEC.

items.name: Equipment noise limits
items.content: Maximum sound pressure level at 1 m per equipment type and tag for datasheets and requisitions; to MECH and INST.

items.name: Noise study results and mitigation
items.content: Noise contours, fence-line levels, hearing protection zones, required mitigation (silencers, enclosures, acoustic insulation).

items.name: Safety model review comments
items.content: Model review comments on spacing (API 2510/NFPA 30), escape and access, firefighting access, valve operability in fire zones; tracked to closure.

items.name: Hazardous area classification review comments
items.content: Comments on missing sources, classification extents, gas group/T-class.

items.name: C&E and SIL verification review comments
items.content: Comments where achieved SIL is below target, missing trips or executive actions, proof test intervals inconsistent with LOPA.

items.name: Vendor SHE review comments
items.content: Technical bid and vendor document comments: noise exceedances, emission guarantee gaps, missing safety devices, package HAZOP requirements.

items.name: Package and revalidation HAZOP actions
items.content: Recommendations from package HAZOPs and change revalidation sessions with responsible discipline and priority.

items.name: PSM process safety information package
items.content: PSI index: chemical hazards, technology information, equipment information, PHA reports and close-out, safe operating limits; to OWNR.

items.name: RMP offsite consequence and registration data
items.content: Worst-case and alternative release scenarios, endpoint distances, residential population and environmental receptors affected, program level, registration data for EPA submission by OWNR.

items.name: Emergency response planning data
items.content: Credible emergency scenarios, hazard zones, alarm tones, muster and evacuation routes, firefighting resources and pre-fire plan data.

items.name: Construction environmental compliance requirements
items.content: SWPPP BMPs, inspection frequencies, dust and waste controls, construction start notifications, temporary facility siting per API 753; to CONS.

items.name: MOC safety review decisions
items.content: Per change: safety impact classification, required reviews (HAZOP, LOPA, siting, F&G), PSI documents to update, approval or rejection.

items.name: PSSR checklist and findings
items.content: Per system: checklist items, findings, pre-startup and post-startup actions, responsible party, status.

items.name: PSSR sign-off
items.content: Approval to introduce hydrocarbons per system, with conditions and authorizing signatures.

items.name: Startup environmental compliance records
items.content: Agency notifications, stack test protocols, CEMS certification plan, LDAR component inventory and monitoring schedule; to OWNR.

items.name: As-built safety studies
items.content: Final revisions of siting study, F&G mapping, QRA, fire water and fireproofing studies; to OWNR via handover.

gaps.info: Site and corporate incident history and owner HAZID guideword set
Neighbouring facilities, land boundaries and offsite population around candidate sites
Local fire department and mutual aid capabilities and insurer (property) requirements
Permit strategy approval, responsible official signatory and agency pre-application meeting outcomes
Building occupancy hours and personnel counts per building (permanent and portable)
Onsite and offsite population distribution and ignition source data for QRA
Flare stack height, tip type and diameter, and flare location basis
Operations and maintenance attendees and previous PHAs of similar units
Offsite public and environmental receptors, five-year accident history and emergency response program for RMP
Site emergency organization, mutual aid agreements and local responder resources
Operator training records and emergency response readiness confirmation
